review_evidence: Reviewed the 26-primary-file LeanDidax2 development and its automatic-differentiation modules. The source implements forward and reverse differentiation constructions rather than merely wrapping an external tool.

The hydrated source contains 286 declaration-style definitions/structures, including tangent-carrying `Value`, JVP/VJP/gradient constructions, numerical gradients, Jacobians, custom derivative rules and differentiable control-flow transformations.

Although the project is executable/pedagogical and does not present theorem declarations, its typed differentiation constructions and transformation interfaces are substantive mathematical/computational formal prior art, so source-level retirement would be lossy.
summary: Reviewed LeanDidax2 and retain its substantial typed automatic-differentiation constructions and transformation interfaces.
